review_proposals.title: Notice for an observed failed check
review_proposals.target_mode: premature_completion after the agent has seen an error or mismatch
review_proposals.what_to_build: Detect explicit command failures or comparison mismatches and append one brief notice to that terminal output asking the agent to reconcile the result before claiming success; do not require a new check or add a model turn.
review_proposals.why: In the review of 80 failed trajectories, many agents claimed completion despite their own last check showing a problem. The existing completion gate rarely rescued bounced attempts. The frequency of *detectable* mismatches is not yet measured, so an 8 pp pass gain is not justified.
review_proposals.how_to_test: First measure trigger frequency and false positives on v0 logs, including whether the mismatch preceded a completion claim. Proceed to fresh paired runs only if coverage is substantial; report passes, turns, tokens, minutes, timeouts, and terminal-outcome mix separately.
review_proposals.risk: A heuristic may mistake acceptable differences for failures, or prompt unproductive repair that consumes the remaining time.

review_proposals.title: Review native tool-call interface
review_proposals.what_to_build: Investigate a native tool-call adapter for the existing agent, with equivalent terminal access and evaluation limits; this is a new mechanism, not a configuration switch.
review_proposals.why: The separate qwen-code agent had far less echo-theater, but its pass rate was tied with the current-style harness. That comparison motivates investigation, not a predicted pass gain.
review_proposals.how_to_test: Check protocol and tool equivalence first, then compare paired fresh runs against v0 for echo-theater, passes, turns, tokens, minutes, and timeouts.
review_proposals.risk: The apparent difference may come from other agent behavior; implementation is substantial and may not improve passes.
